$comment: Owner ruling (2026-07-31), verbatim: the shared contract is not the generator definition (which arguably belongs in summon) — it is the general command types seam and the compositional logic. So THIS file is summon's own DOMAIN spec: what a generator is, in summon's terms, versioned so a change to it is visible. It does not describe, and must not be taken to describe, the contract between a CLI kernel and its commands; extracting that seam is a separate program with its own ADR. v1 is the shape summon-core ships today. A backwards-incompatible change gets a v2 file beside this one, not an edit here.
title: Summon generator definition (v1)
description: The DECLARATIVE projection of a GeneratorDefinition — the parts expressible as data. `generate`, and a prompt's `when`/`validate`, are functions carried by the module and cannot appear in JSON; they are documented here as code-carried so that a reader of this schema is not misled into thinking a JSON document alone is a generator.

prompts.description: The questions whose answers `generate` receives, in ask order.

generate.$comment: CODE-CARRIED, not data: a pure function `(answers) => Task<void>`. Present on every real generator; absent from any JSON projection of one.
generate.description: Declared here for completeness only — a JSON document cannot carry it.

meta.title: Generator metadata
meta.description: What discovery, help and the generated-file stamp read.

name.description: Generator name, used in the CLI path (e.g. `component/react`).

displayName.description: The name written into generated-file stamp comments. Distinct from `name` when the stamp should not be the CLI path (e.g. `@canonical/summon-component:react`). Load-bearing for byte equality: two bins agree on a tree only if they agree on this.

description.description: One-line description shown in generator listings.

version.description: Semantic version of the generator. Also written into the stamp.

help.description: Extended help text shown for `summon <topic>` and `--help`.

examples.description: Usage examples shown in help; each one a common invocation.

prompt.title: Prompt definition
prompt.description: One question. Each prompt also becomes a CLI flag, kebab-cased from `name` (`componentPath` → `--component-path`).

name.description: Unique identifier — the answer key and the flag name.

message.description: Question text displayed to the user.

default.$comment: Unconstrained on purpose: the value's type follows `type` (string for text/select, boolean for confirm, array for multiselect), and pinning that here would duplicate a rule `validateAnswers` already owns.

when.$comment: CODE-CARRIED, not data: `(answers) => boolean`, evaluated against the answers collected so far.
when.description: Declared here for completeness only — a JSON document cannot carry it.

validate.$comment: CODE-CARRIED, not data: `(value) => boolean | string`, returning true or an error message.
validate.description: Declared here for completeness only — a JSON document cannot carry it.

group.description: Group name for organizing options in `--help`. Ungrouped prompts appear under "Options".

positional.description: Whether this prompt can be given as a positional argument. At most one per generator, and only a `text` prompt.
